rv.q: The result is a dynamic story that overcomes a slow start to pack a powerful punch.
Mosaic's show is undeniably entertaining and wonderfully executed in many aspects.
While the music doesn't quite meet the bar set by the book, the production is worth seeing for its message alone.
If that premise sounds incredible to you by itself, then I've got great news: it is, and even occasionally-strained direction can't stop its barreling path forward.
The ending is so satisfyingly happy it reduced the audience to tears.
